title: Gray pilot explains implants as broken instrument tips for antibody harvesting
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Gray pilot explains implants as broken instrument tips for antibody harvesting, about 1963-1965 at off-Earth location, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "Because we take one or two cells of our diseased tissue, put it on that tip and implant it into you, and you will start making antibodies,

plain: Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who later worked in a military unit that trained people to sense faraway places with the mind, says that around 1963 to 1965, somewhere off Earth, a Gray, the short grey-skinned alien of many abduction stories, explained the small implants people find in their bodies. According to Buchanan, the being said they are instrument tips carrying one or two cells of the aliens' own diseased tissue, placed in a human so the person makes antibodies the aliens can collect. If true, it would mean people are being used to make medicine for another species.
